caption:
Your lead leg has to hold your turn. Train it like it. 💪

The split squat with a rotation builds single-leg strength and control while your trunk turns over a planted front leg.
✅ 3 x 6 each leg, slow and controlled
✅ Drop straight down, then turn over the front hip
❌ Don't let the front knee cave or the trunk wobble

Comment "LEAD" if this is going in your next workout.
